case_text:
A regional bakery is losing weekday customers since a supermarket chain opened a bakery counter nearby.
The owner has savings and a lease on the shop for three more years.
objective: How should the bakery respond to the new competitor?
gold_facts: A regional bakery is losing weekday customers since a supermarket chain opened a bakery counter nearby.
The owner has savings and a lease on the shop for three more years.

case_text:
A software company sells a project tool to small firms.
Churn has risen since a cheaper rival launched a free tier.
The company has one year of cash reserve.
objective: Should the company cut prices or add premium features?
gold_facts: A software company sells a project tool to small firms.
Churn has risen since a cheaper rival launched a free tier.
The company has one year of cash reserve.
